scope: Live site/player observations and HTTP subtitle retrieval; not an installed-extension end-to-end test.

sites.mechanism: Dynamically inserted cross-origin iframe; JW Player renders captions outside native textTracks. Eleven caption choices observed.
Hydration inserts iframe. Inline player configuration has subtitles objects with url, language, format, default.
sites.notes: Initial server-rendered no-streaming-servers message was transient; browser hydration succeeded.

sites.mechanism: strmcx-embed open shadow root contains iframe. Parent receives encoded binary source API response; decrypted track metadata transfers via MessagePort. Child iframe inserts native track elements.
Player data is JSON.parse of a JavaScript string embedded in x-data. Double escaped JSON quotes and slash escapes; subtitles array contains title, format, language, default, forced, file.
Astro-island props encode subtitles as [1, [[0, {language:[0,value], name:[0,value], src:[0,url]}]]]. Hydrated player renders native subtitles.
requirements: decode HTML entities and tuple props

sites.mechanism: Static player source shows ASS track objects {id, src, label, srcLang, type}; lazy subtitle renderer uses subUrl and setTrackByUrl, with worker initialization. Browser navigated to google.com without interaction before subtitle capture.
sites.notes: Public stream API request returned 403. Cause of browser navigation not established; no protection bypass attempted.

sites.mechanism: Authenticated site XHR GET api.animeonsen.xyz/v4/content/<content>/video/<episode> returns data.uri.subtitles language-to-URL map. SubtitlesOctopus receives subUrl and renders ASS through a worker/canvas.
sites.notes: Native video has no caption tracks. Public HTTP request lacked anonymous site session and returned 401. No user credentials captured.
